title: Rafram bar Papa of Sikhra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 31b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.31b.9), where Rav Acha son of Rav Yosef asked Rav Ashi: do we require three handbreadths? And in response to this, Rafram bar Papa of Sikhra said: one handbreadth.
In [Bava Metzia 42a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.42a.8-9), the reading is only “Rafram of Sikhra,” with the patronymic bar Papa omitted.

Hyman writes that he found a valuable reading in Dikdukei Soferim: “Rafram said: It stands to reason—a handbreadth.” Hyman concludes that he is in fact the unqualified Rafram who presided in the year תשמד (744), as discussed above.[^1]

notes.text: Both passages give one handbreadth for concealing money. The Bavli’s two name forms can be compared in [Heilprin’s Rafram of Sikhra entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3251&lang=en). Hyman reports a different reading from Dikdukei Soferim and draws a different identification from it. The number 744 is given without a stated calendar era.
